bullets: Added an in-terminal profile survey that appears while the assistant is working, allowing you to answer up to ten questions for a 5 freebucks reward.
Enabled partners to select and activate advertisements directly from the slash command menu using keyboard navigation.
Removed the 10 Freebucks per hour promotional price on GLM 5.3 Flash, returning it to the standard 15 Freebucks per hour.
Added the Glyph Cluster model to the Unlimited section of the model picker.
Marked the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast model as 'New' instead of 'Recommended' in the model picker.
Updated the model picker to use shorter labels and help text for GPT-6 Luna and Solar Pro 4.
Changed the default model for new desktop and browser workspaces to depend on the time of day and your access level.
Removed the rough dollar estimate from the account activity report, showing only message and token counts.
Fixed a session error so the terminal assistant correctly identifies when a free model is refunded or closed, rather than assuming a takeover.
Removed Space Bunny Alpha from the free model picker after its hosting provider stopped accepting traffic.
Retired DeepSeek V4 Pro from the free tier, ending its use as a backup model.
Fixed the GLM 5.3 Flash model to default to a 'high' thinking level, preventing repetitive loops during long tasks.
Added a link to the account appeal page in the terminal message shown when an account is suspended.
Made the system immediately report when a free model is too busy to start a task, instead of waiting to retry.
Fixed a safety check on macOS so sponsored tasks are not incorrectly blocked when files are linked in two places.
Ensured older Claude model names in your settings now route to the current working versions.
Prevented user links in advertising data from opening malicious or non-Web address types.
